description: Pure enrichment module exposing compute_score(metadata) that returns (float, dict). Addresses signal quality weakness: only 4 distinct values, poor discrimination. Uses metadata fields: age_days, last_updated, update_frequency_days, version_stability, deprecation_notice_present, registry_source, dependency_count. Computes stability scores based on update cadence, version consistency, and temporal patterns. Penalizes erratic update schedules. No DB writes, no network, no imports of protected modules. Completes in <2s per call. Returns evidence dict listing fields used and partial scores derived from each.
